methodology.memoryDescription: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage, independent fields and same-sample sum when all available. Native codec allocations may be absent. Host workerd RSS is process-wide and includes other isolates/runtime. No forced GC during workloads.
methodology.coldDescription: Fresh Wrangler/workerd per named case. Fixture is encoded first; firstDecodeMs measures first unpack in fresh isolate, excluding process startup and I/O.
